verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents agents built in Copilot/Studio that you can schedule (skyvern-docs-29). They run unattended in a cloud browser (skyvern-docs-33, skyvern-docs-5) and handle logins, 2FA and CAPTCHAs on their own (skyvern-docs-36, skyvern-docs-37, skyvern-docs-44). They notify via a webhook POST when a run finishes (skyvern-docs-38), and every run is recorded for later review (skyvern-docs-11). The core of autonomous background automation is clearly delivered, but scheduling rests on a single brief mention. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling/trigger documentation (cron, recurring runs, event triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled runs.
